text: Primary source: D:/BGI_Win_Probability/reports/model_results/model_comparison.csv and model_metadata.json. The Random Forest was selected by the lowest held-out conditional match log loss; calibration used expanding chronological match-group folds. The test contains six later matches (96 team rows), so the result is preliminary. The always-loss accuracy baseline is 90/96 = 93.75%, based on six winning team rows among 96 team rows. Feature importance is descriptive and not causal.

text: Primary source: D:/BGI_Win_Probability/reports/model_results/player_finish_model_comparison.csv and player_finish_model_metadata.json. The test covers six chronological matches and 384 player-match rows. Random Forest MAE is 1.091915 and rolling-average MAE is 1.106989, a difference of 0.015073 finishes per player-match. Random Forest RMSE (1.435741) and R-squared (-0.004730) are worse than the rolling-average baseline (1.424499 and 0.010944). The source does not supply match-level MVP-award labels. This model predicts finishes only.
